title: Animals and their homes
examples: What is a baby goat called?
Can dogs live in the wild?

explain.say: Animals live in many places. Some animals live with people. These animals are called pets.
Some animals live on a farm. Cows, sheep and hens live on farms.
Some animals live in the wild. They find their own food. A monkey lives in the jungle.

draw.text: Wild animals find their own food

explain.say: The place where an animal lives is its habitat. A fish lives in water. A bird builds a nest in a tree.
Baby animals have their own names. A baby dog is a puppy. A baby goat is a kid.

draw.text: Puppy: baby dog. Kid: baby goat.

faq.a: Wild animals sleep in their own homes. This could be a cave, a burrow or a tree.
asks: What is a wild animal's bed?
Where do they sleep in nature?

faq.q: Are pets always kept inside houses?
faq.a: Pets can live in houses or in safe places outside, like a hutch. They need space to play.
asks: Where do we keep our pets?
Is a pet always in a house?

faq.q: What is the difference between a farm and the wild?
faq.a: On a farm, people look after the animals. In the wild, animals look after themselves.
asks: Is a farm part of the wild?

faq.q: What is a baby animal called?
faq.a: Many baby animals have their own names. A baby cow is a calf. A baby cat is a kitten.
asks: What is a baby dog called?

faq.q: Do all animals have a habitat?
faq.a: Yes, every animal has a habitat. It gives the animal food, water and shelter.
asks: Does every animal have a home?
What do animals need to live?

facts: Pets are animals kept by people for companionship.
Farms are places where people raise farm animals.
The wild is nature that is not controlled by people.
An animal's natural home is called its habitat.
Baby animals have names different from the adult animals.

quiz.say: Look at the fish. Tap its home.
quiz.why: A fish lives in water. The sea is full of water.

wrong.0: A nest is a home for birds.
wrong.2: A barn is a home for farm animals, like cows.

quiz.say: Look at the goat. Tap where goats usually live.
quiz.why: Goats usually live on farms. Farmers look after them.

wrong.1: The sea is a home for fish and whales.
wrong.2: The jungle is a home for wild animals, like monkeys.

quiz.say: Look at the baby dog. Tap its name.
quiz.why: A baby dog is called a puppy.

wrong.0: A kitten is a baby cat.
wrong.1: A calf is a baby cow.
